text:
janelle: Hey team — promo code CGIFT-Q3 applied to Hosted credits on acct_3087 but we actually purchased Dedicated reserved capacity (SKU: DED-ANNUAL-1). Checkout TX-9823 was this morning. Can someone confirm where the credit landed?

maya: Sorry about that — can you paste the acct id and txn? I can pull the billing logs.

janelle: acct_3087, TX-9823, promo CGIFT-Q3. We need the $5,000 credit applied to Dedicated so it shows on the reservation invoice, not hosted usage.

billing-bot: Promo application detected: promo=CGIFT-Q3, target_product=hosted_credits, amount=5000, applied_at=1755604200

chris: Looking now — system mapping shows CGIFT-Q3 is tagged hosted_default in the promo ingestion table. That explains why it landed on hosted_credits. @samir any recent changes to promo ingestion?

samir: Yep, last deploy changed the ingestion to prefer vendor_sku if present. If webhook omits product_type it defaults to hosted. Repro (in infra):
```
# repro POST that caused incorrect default
curl -X POST https://internal-api/promos \
  -d '{"code":"CGIFT-Q3","sku":"DED-ANNUAL-1"}'
# internal normalizer currently sets product_type=hosted when vendor field missing
```
This was a regression in promo-normalizer v2.3.4.

maya: Ok. For immediate fix I can create a manual billing adjustment to move $5,000 from hosted_credits to dedicated_credits for acct_3087. Do you want me to proceed, @janelle?

janelle: Please proceed — we need the invoice updated by EOD.

chris: I'll raise a high-priority billing-adjustment BA-2025-77 and flag finance for expedited approval.

billing-bot: Created billing adjustment BA-2025-77. Status: pending_approval. Related promo: CGIFT-Q3, original_tx=TX-9823

maya: Pinged finance; approval ETA ~2 hours. Once approved I'll apply and void the hosted credit so they don't get double credit.

billing-bot: Adjustment BA-2025-77 approved and executed at 1755604800. Invoice INV-2025-334 updated: dedicated_credit +5000, hosted_credit -5000.

janelle: Confirmed — invoice shows the dedicated credit now. Thank you all :pray:

maya: Closing this thread after we add a hotfix to promo-normalizer. Samir, can you cut a patch to default product_type from sku parsing instead of hosted default?

samir: Yep, will cut v2.3.5 with a migration that infers product_type from sku patterns and add a unit test. Deploying now.

chris: Follow-up action: add an automated check in promos ingestion to fail on ambiguous product_type and alert billing-team.

janelle: Appreciate the quick turnaround.

maya: Marking resolved — will update the customer-facing ticket with BA-2025-77 and INV-2025-334 references.
